title: Koordinator
summary: Use the coordinator to route bounded work, track progress and bring results back for review.

workflows.label: Delegate a bounded goal
workflows.summary: Describe the outcome and acceptance evidence before delegating work.

commands.description: Start a terminal session with the Koordinator agent selected.
commands.expect: The Koordinator agent is the selected session agent.

steps.action: Open the coordinator in the workspace where the work belongs.
State the desired outcome, scope, constraints, and concrete acceptance checks; ask for a progress and evidence report.
Review proposed task ownership and wait for the coordinator's completion evidence.
Use /hub status to check active, open and stalled work, then ask for the next evidence report.
Verify the delivered changes and tests yourself before accepting the result.

media.alt: Kollab coordinator view organizing agent tasks and progress
media.caption: Give the coordinator a bounded outcome and reviewable acceptance checks.

workflows.success: The coordinator routes work to agents, tracks reported progress and returns results for your review.

recovery.symptom: The coordinator returns only a plan
recovery.action: Ask it to perform or assign the concrete work and report completed paths, test commands and observed results.

recovery.symptom: A task is stalled or lacks evidence
recovery.action: Ask for current ownership, blockers and the next check; do not treat a planned or worker-reported step as independently verified.

recovery.symptom: The supervisor reports that coordinator turns have stopped
recovery.action: Check the provider profile, /compact status and the app log before assigning more work.

workflows.note: Delegation does not replace human review. Coordinator or worker claims still need evidence from the relevant files and checks.
